outcome: Pregnancy outcomes (spontaneous abortion, congenital anomalies, premature birth, caesarean section rate)
Disease activity in pregnant women with JIA
cohort: 152 pregnancies in 98 women with JIA and 39 pregnancies involving 21 male partners of women with JIA
finding: No significant differences in pregnancy outcomes were observed between DMARD-exposed and -unexposed pregnancies in women with JIA.
